svg.title: Placement evidence: three arms of the same chunks in one process
svg.desc: Panel A: 96 of 96 candidate windows contain a Neural Engine prediction and 0 of 96 contain GPU work of the process; the GPU control is 0 and 96; the CPU control is 0 and 0; two idle recordings contain no predictions. Panel B: per-call busy share; candidate calls are about 78 to 81 percent Neural Engine busy for layer chunks and 44 percent for the head; GPU control calls are 34 to 75 percent GPU busy.
svg.text: Placement evidence: three arms of the same chunks in one process
iPhone 18 Pro, iOS 27.2, Release build; 8 chunks × 12 calls per arm
0 Neural Engine predictions in 41.9 and 41.9 s; inside candidate windows: 100.4 per second
B Busy share of each call window3
1. A window is one call, from the start of its inference interval to the end of its readback interval.
2. The process’s CPU time was not sampled in this recording, so CPU execution is inferred from the absence of both signals, not measured.
3. One bar per call, in chunk order; a full-height bar is 100% of the window.
